cards.title: Kai Holmberg scores

cards.story: A 9-pass move, 36.8 seconds from start to finish, pulled Ashvale Rovers apart. A 0.12 xG chance from 14.0 m, struck at 96.4 km/h.

claims.text: Kestrel Bay FC strung 9 passes together before the shot.

fr.caption: Kestrel Bay FC a enchaîné 9 passes en 36,8 s, générant un tir à 0,12 xG à 14 m pour égaliser 2-2.

ar.caption: كسترل باي نفذت 9 تمريرات خلال 36.8 ثانية، وخلقت فرصة تسديدة بقيمة 0.12 xG من 14 م لتعديل النتيجة 2-2.

en.caption: Kestrel Bay made 9 passes in about 37 seconds before Kai Holmberg scored from 14 m to tie the game 2-2.

fr.caption: Kestrel Bay a fait 9 passes en 37 secondes avant que Kai Holmberg n'égalise à 14 m, 2-2.

ar.caption: كسترل باي مرروا الكرة 9 مرات خلال 37 ثانية قبل أن يسجل كاي هولمبيرغ من 14 متر ويعادل النتيجة 2-2.

issues: Incorrect team formation attribution: Kestrel Bay FC is the away team and is correctly stated as 4-2-3-1 in facts, but the claim says they switched to 4-2-3-1 as a tactical adjustment, which is not supported by facts (formation is static).
The claim that Kestrel Bay FC has been 'clearly on top in the last five minutes' is supported by pulse_team_on_top and pulse_dominance_strength facts, so it stands.
The possession claim matches the facts and stands.

Claim that the match is evenly poised with 50% possession each is incorrect; facts show both teams have exactly 50% possession, which is balanced, but 'evenly poised' implies a balanced match which is contradicted by 'pulse_team_on_top' showing Kestrel Bay FC clearly on top.

Claim that Kestrel Bay FC has clear control and pressure is not fully supported; while 'pulse_team_on_top' is Kestrel Bay FC and 'pulse_dominance_strength' is 'clear', the 'pulse_tempo' is 'contested' indicating the match is competitive, so describing it as 'clear control and pressure' overstates the facts.
The story states the buildup was 37 seconds, but the fact 'buildup_seconds' is 36.8; while minor, the claim should match the exact fact.

fallbacks: analyst: overturned twice, rulebook-safe version aired

recap.title: Full-time recap
recap.headline: Mensah-Cole's hat-trick seals Ashvale Rovers win
recap.story: Ashvale Rovers edged Kestrel Bay FC 3-2 in a thrilling encounter. Yaw Mensah-Cole's early brace gave Ashvale a strong start, but Kestrel Bay fought back to level by the 71st minute. The turning point came in stoppage time when Mensah-Cole scored his third goal, securing the victory. Despite being a man down after Adebayo Lorne's red card, Kestrel Bay showed resilience but couldn't find an equalizer. Mensah-Cole's 13 shots and 1.65 xG made him the standout player.

claims.text: Yaw Mensah-Cole scored a hat-trick including the winning goal at 90+2'.

Ashvale Rovers had higher xG (1.74) compared to Kestrel Bay FC (0.73).
Kestrel Bay FC equalized at 71' after switching to a 4-2-3-1 formation.
Ashvale Rovers maintained more shots (17) and shots on target (8).
